Messrs [Harper](/person/248)
I am much obliged for the [£10](/topic/160) for [Love and Life](/book/137) received on the 14th yesterday. I am also much obliged to you for sending me your ‘[paper for young people](/periodical/250).’[^1] I ventured to extract a short poem on the Plumes of Crecy for a [Reading Book for schools](/book/150) making however a few alterations to bring it more into accordance with history than romance[^2]
Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge


[^1]: There is a pencil line beside the mention of the reading book and ‘Is not this worth mention?’ written in pencil. Underneath, in ink ‘Attended to./ S.S.C.’
[^2]: Lillie E. Barr, ‘The Plumes of Creçy’ was included in [English History Reading Books](/book/150) III, 106-9, with a note ‘in Harper’s Young People (slightly altered)’. CMY has reciprocated the American [piracy](/topic/172) of her work.
